title: Mai Tai Wallet
tagline: LLM-powered crypto wallet that turns complex actions into simple conversations. Swap tokens, provide liquidity, or mint NFTs just by chatting
description:
Intent-based wallet that simplifies crypto interactions.

Want to trade? The AI finds the best routes across DEXs. 

Want to earn yield? AI and it analyzes current opportunities across lending, staking, and LP protocols. 

Creating NFTs? Just describe your idea and mint. 

Want to sell all your tokens? Just type "Sell everything" 

The wallet transforms complex DeFi operations into simple chats while maintaining security and user control.

The main value is in saving end users time when executing txs, as well as reducing complexity.
how_its_made:
We use: 

> Coinbase onchain kit - smart wallet to spawn the user wallet with self hosted private keys on the device.
> LLM fusion library to use different LLMs depending on the context. 
> Blockscout API - verifying token addresses, getting ABI arrays of the tokens, retrieving token lists, e.t.c.
